name: The Ancient Statuette
summary: Near Zoram Strand, Talen searches for the statuette lost in the naga attack. The elf has made camp on Ashenvale’s northwestern coast and needs you to recover the relic he dropped in the surf.

sections.title: Ambush on the Coast
sections.body: Naga attacked Talen as he guided a small vessel through the shallows near Zoram’s sunken ruins. He reached shore with only bare provisions and made camp in haste. In his flight, he dropped the ancient statuette he had found among the ruins into the sand.

sections.title: Secrets of Old Zoram
sections.body: Talen braved the naga at Zoram Strand to seek the ancient statuette. When you return it, he tells you the drowned city holds centuries of forgotten mysteries. He believes the delicate carving may unlock what remains hidden beneath the tides.

faq.q: Who is Talen and why is he alone on the Strand?
faq.answer: Talen is an elf explorer who made camp along the southern edge of Zoram Strand. His curiosity about history led him to the drowned ruins, where naga ambushed his vessel and drove him ashore.

faq.q: Where did Talen lose the statuette?
faq.answer: Talen lost the statuette near the shoreline north of his camp. It lies half-buried in the sand beside an overturned boat and fallen tree, along the surf where his vessel was attacked.
The ancient statuette is a night elven relic recovered from Zoram’s submerged ruins. Talen says it has historical and mystical significance and may unlock the drowned city’s lingering secrets.

faq.q: Why are there naga at the Zoram Strand?
faq.answer: Naga have claimed Zoram’s drowned ruins as their territory. They patrol Ashenvale’s western beaches against outsiders near elven ruins that sank beneath the sea ten thousand years ago, before the Sundering.

faq.q: What happens after returning the statuette?
faq.answer: Returning the statuette helps Talen decipher more of the region’s mysteries. The naga threat remains, and you are directed toward their leader, Ruuzel.
The statuette lies at the water’s edge in territory crawling with hostile naga warriors and shore-stalking beasts. Retrieving it is perilous for a lone wanderer.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you know Zoram’s ruins as remnants of Kaldorei civilization from before the Great Sundering. Preserving artifacts like the statuette keeps ancestral memory alive.
As an Alliance traveler in Ashenvale, you face threats from Horde outposts in the east and hostile naga along the western coast.
